read.en: Amazon edged up 0.4% on Oct 26 to $249.09, trading between $247.24 and $250.79. It is below the falling 5-day ($254.5), 10-day ($255.2) and 100-day ($251.8) averages and the rising 30-day ($253.3), and above the rising 200-day ($243.3). MACD crossed below its signal on Oct 23 and is now below zero; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 22 ($264.25), and RSI is 44.
read.zh: 亚马逊 10月26日微涨 0.4%，收于 $249.09，盘中区间 $247.24–250.79。股价位于下行的 5 日（$254.5）、10 日（$255.2）和 100 日均线（$251.8）以及上行的 30 日均线（$253.3）下方，高于上行的 200 日均线（$243.3）。MACD 于 10月23日下穿信号线，现已跌破零轴；抛物线 SAR 自 10月22日起看空（$264.25），RSI 为 44。

read.en: A narrow day: the $250.8 high tested the $248.6–250 resistance and the close stayed just under $249.3, while the low held above Friday's $246.5. Resistance is $249.3–250.8, then $251.8–253.3 (100 and 30-day) and $254.5–255.2 (5 and 10-day). Support is $246.5, then $243.3–244.7 (200-day, September lows). A close above $253.3 would target $255–258; a close below $243.3 would open the $226 July lows.

r.en: Oct 15 and Oct 16 lows $248.6, now resistance; Oct 26 high $250.8
